name: OSS_BALANCE_BILL_ADJUSTMENTS
description: Following table is used to capture balance bill adjustment information.

columns.name: BALANCE_BILL_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for balance bill line adjustments.

columns.name: BALANCE_BILL_ADJUSTMENT_PUID
columns.description: Alternate identifier for balance bill line adjustments.

columns.name: BALANCE_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the balance bill line linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the bill line linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ROOT_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the root bill line linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: PARENT_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the parent bill line linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: USAGE_BILL_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the usage bill line adjustment linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: CHARGE_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the charge adjustment linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STEP_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: This field stores the step sequence number of charge adjustment linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: This field stores the sequence number of charge adjustment linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: This field stores the category of charge adjustment linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: This field stores the type of charge adjustment linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_VALUE
columns.description: This field stores the adjustment value linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS_ELEMENT
columns.description: This field stores the adjustment basis element linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_BASIS_ELEMENT_VALUE
columns.description: This field stores the adjustment basis element value linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: This field stores the adjustment amount linked to the balance bill line adjustment.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
